kitze/skillbox: Self-hosted, versioned skills library for AI agents. MCP, scoped clients, and optional Jev recommendations.
awlevin/typesafe-computer-use: Computer use for about $0.0002 a step: OCR the screen, classify the next action with TypeSafe, click. macOS.
sutro-sh/jev-align: Build calibrated AI Functions from human feedback using Jev and GEPA.
caio0452/jev_search
donvito/jev-dev: UI tool you can use to experiment with Jev by Typesafe.ai
jexp/neo4jev: Typesafe.ai System One Model Jev navigating a Neo4j graph by using a classifier over neighbouring relationships
nokia-applied-research/AnyJev: Turn any LLM into a Jev-style decision model: typed decisions, real probabilities, no training. (continue updating)
SamratDuttaOfficial/WaterSheep: A decision model that returns calibrated answers to yes/no, choice, score and multi-label questions.
FeiLiuEM/tetrajev: High-performance, high-precision, locally-fast-deployed Jev-class decision service — four readings, one routed decision, zero training.

leepokai/jev-guard: Auto mode for every coding agent, built on Jev: risk-scores every tool call with session context (deny / ask / allow), flags prompt injection in results, checks skills and plugins. Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, pi, OpenCode, ACP.
samuelfaj/distill: Get FAR MORE done with FAR FEWER tokens 🔥
miuuyy/Astra-Ares: Adaptive reasoning effort for GPT-6 during Codex tasks, powered by Jev to reduce token usage.
thruwire/foreman: An agent supervisor and software factory foreman powered by decision models

transcendr/jevpact: Compact Codex at useful work transitions, then continue safely.

Asymptote-Labs/agent-beacon: The cross-harness self-improving memory layer for AI agents.

grandamenium/jev-anything: Agent skill for designing, building, testing, and tuning bounded JEV decision layers
romanmeclazcke/codex-sift: Route each Codex turn to the cheapest model that can handle it, judged by TypeSafe Jev.
integrate-your-mind/jev-codex-plugin: Jev Workflows for Codex and Claude Code: open-source decision consultation, failure diagnosis, and evidence-based completion review
ansidium/jev-codex-bridge: Jev model and reasoning-effort routing for Codex Desktop and CLI
typakon4/jev-layer: Portable System-1 decision layer for agent harnesses with host-owned routing, receipts, replay, and fail-open integrations.
jackbarunz/jev-tool-router: Jev-powered MCP tool routing for Codex
teempai/jev-in-codex: Jev-powered tool and skill selection, context search, and output triage for Codex via MCP
leonaaardob/fast-dev-compaction: Codex plugin: verbatim Jev-guided context restoration around session compaction. Port of tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction to Codex lifecycle hooks.
miniLV/Jev-Auto-Router: Jev Auto Router: turn-pinned model and effort routing for Codex via TypeSafe Jev.
Noe1120/jev-advisor: A private, local decision-advice Skill for Codex that ranks tool choices, estimates risks, guides recovery, and checks completion evidence.
chaseai-yt/jev-audit: Find where TypeSafe Jev fits your real workflows. An evidence-based audit skill for Claude Code, Codex, and compatible agents.
jsk4581/jev-blindspot: A prompt reviewer for Claude Code and Codex CLI. Finds the blind spots in each prompt you send and shows them in a local web UI, or in the CLI with the Claude Code mod.
backant-io/jevelry: Use Jev everywhere to make & track decisions
kenming/codex-route-advisor: Adaptive model and reasoning router for Codex agents, with optional Jev-powered task assessment.
peterwanghot/jev-cc-codex-router: Per-turn model routing proxy for Codex: asks Jev which tier each task needs, rewrites the model, retries flaky upstream errors.
sherajdev/jev-research: Practical guide to using TypeSafe Jev with Herdr and Claude, Codex, Hermes, and browser agents.

wangzhezbz/jev-pilot: An all-in-one Jev plugin for Codex. Bringing automatic reasoning-effort routing, context filtering, and workflow assistance to macOS, Windows, and Linux. Under active development.
killerz3/jevalyzer: Grade the agent sessions already on your disk. Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI and Antigravity, scored with Jev for cents.

onlyjq04/jev-agent-hooks: TypeSafe Jev hooks for Claude Code, Codex and pi: per-turn skill suggestion and subagent model routing
chrisstarr7/jev-kit: Codex Skill and MCP for bounded, advisory decisions in Java backend development.
caohaolin556/jev-vibe-coding-pm: A lightweight Codex plugin for evidence-driven product guidance.

alexj11324/open-jev-approvals: Binary approval gate for Codex and Claude Code — every intercepted tool call is reviewed by TypeSafe JEV and composed through a versioned local policy, with scoped authorization.
ctmx/openrouter-jev-mcp: High-speed System One Jev AI decision gateway and MCP server powered by OpenRouter
PhilippElhaus/Codex-Decision: Local Codex tool-output filtering with OpenAI Decisions by default and optional TypeSafe Jev support.
xiaoxiaomugong/jev-bugfix: A Codex skill for bounded Jev-assisted bug investigation, root-cause analysis, and verified fixes.
satiricalguru/Fast-Jev-Agents: High-performance verbatim context compaction for coding agents (Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Gemini, OpenCode)
